technical.summary: Overbought short-term momentum (RSI-9 at 91.79) with weak accumulation (negative CMF) and insufficient trend strength (ADX 28) creates high pullback risk despite long-term bullish structure; entry timing is poor.

fundamental.summary: PNW shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 33 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-equivalent 25) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and recent news data limit conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed positioning.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (360.64), flat yield curve recession signal, and rising USD create severely unfavourable macro backdrop for utilities; earnings in 33 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, price above major MAs, supertrend bullish) with contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX crisis) offers asymmetric risk/reward for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (91.79) with weak accumulation (negative CMF), insufficient trend strength (ADX 28), zero fundamental conviction, and crisis macro backdrop (VIX 360.64, flat yield curve, rising USD) create unacceptable near-term pullback risk with no catalyst support.
